channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: How to Add BNB Smart Chain to MetaMask for Mainnet
item.description: To add BNB Smart Chain to MetaMask, connect through Chainlist, approve the Mainnet details, and select the network before using apps or receiving assets.

item.title: BEP-20 is BNB Smart Chain’s token standard
item.description: What is the BEP-20 token standard? It is BNB Smart Chain’s token format, built around familiar ERC-20 functions and used with 0x addresses on chain ID 56.

item.title: What does total value locked mean in DeFi lending? The cash left
item.description: What does total value locked mean in DeFi lending? It is the USD value of supplied assets still in the protocol after borrowed funds are subtracted.

item.title: How do you buy a token on Arbitrum One from an exchange?
item.description: Buy ETH on your exchange, withdraw it to a wallet on Arbitrum One, then use Matcha swap to trade for the token and confirm its balance in the wallet.

item.title: US Seeks Forfeiture of $1.1B in Binance Hack USDC
item.description: A civil filing seeks more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to the Binance theft, expanding a recovery effort while leaving final forfeiture to the courts.

item.title: How to Set an Arrival Alert for Gnosis Chain Tokens
item.description: Learn how to get notified when a transfer arrives on Gnosis Chain: add the receiving address to a GnosisScan Watch List and enable ERC-20 token alerts.

item.title: UniswapX’s Dutch-auction order flow
item.description: How UniswapX works: you sign a Permit2 order whose price decays; fillers compete to execute it, pay the gas and choose a route at fill time.

item.title: TeleSwap transfers: follow the BTC and the proof
item.description: TeleSwap lockers vs relayers roles: relayers prove Bitcoin deposits on-chain; Lockers hold BTC, back it with collateral and pay it out when teleBTC is burned.

item.title: Bridged Tokens on Sui: Suibridge’s Lock-and-Mint Model
item.description: How bridged tokens stay backed on Sui: Suibridge locks ETH as WETH on Ethereum, then mints a Sui token that can be burned to redeem the asset.

item.title: SparkLend Frequently Asked Questions: How Lending Works
item.description: SparkLend frequently asked questions, answered: learn how supplying earns interest, borrowing uses collateral, and liquidations affect a lending position.

item.title: How much gas to budget after bridging Bitcoin: estimate each action
item.description: How much gas to budget on the destination chain after bridging Bitcoin? Estimate each planned transaction in the chain’s native token, plus room for a retry.

item.title: Fraxswap long-term orders: how the TWAMM fills them
item.description: How long does a Fraxswap long-term order take to execute? It runs for your chosen intervals, with the end set on an interval boundary and proceeds available to withdraw.

item.title: How to Read an Approval and Identify Its Spender
item.description: Read token approval history to identify a spender: find the address in the ERC-20 Approval event, then check it against the dapp’s official contract details.

item.title: What to Check Before Buying a Memecoin With a Burner Wallet
item.description: What to check before buying a memecoin with a burner wallet: verify the Solana mint, active authorities, pool liquidity and holder concentration before swapping.

item.title: Hong Kong bill widens crypto licensing to four services
item.description: Hong Kong has gazetted a bill requiring crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians to register or obtain SFC licences, widening oversight beyond exchanges.

item.title: What Is a Canonical Bridge on Sui, and How Does It Differ?
item.description: What is a canonical bridge in crypto? It is the chain-designated route whose token version an ecosystem treats as standard; faster routes can carry different trust trade-offs.

item.title: MoonPay seeks OCC trust charter for stablecoin operations
item.description: MoonPay has applied for a national trust bank charter to offer custody, stablecoin issuance and reserve management, pending review by the OCC.

item.title: Bitcoin bridge break-even: fixed costs and fee share
item.description: The minimum amount of bitcoin worth bridging depends on fixed costs and your fee limit: divide those costs by the fee room left after percentage charges.

item.title: Burner wallets for memecoins: when the extra effort pays
item.description: Is a burner wallet worth it for buying memecoins? Yes, when you sign for unfamiliar trades: it limits wallet-level losses, but adds transfers, fees and key management.

item.title: Unknown Token Approvals: Permission or Wallet Compromise
item.description: Does an unknown token approval mean a wallet was hacked? Usually no: an old permission can remain active, so identify the spender and revoke it if untrusted.
